No account · No ads · Local document handling
RME processes your documents on this device.
Document, Batch, Book, QR, business card, receipt and table capture use the camera when you allow it. Google auto scan manages its own camera access. You can also import a file.
Save to RME keeps a private library copy. Deleted documents stay in the Recycle bin until you permanently delete them or clear app data.
RME PDF Scanner does not operate cloud storage.
You choose where to save or share copies. The destination may have its own cloud storage.
RME PDF Scanner does not operate advertising, tracking, or analytics.
Google ML Kit may send encrypted diagnostics and usage metrics. Your images and recognized text stay on the device during recognition.

Only the front image is available. Sharp and colored marks are protected; faint or defocused front writing can be ambiguous. Some ghosting may remain. Compare fine writing and Cancel if unsure. Creases, stains and moiré are outside this filter.
Reduce soft crease shadows and faint stains on near-white paper. This replaces the page filter and keeps rotation, brightness and contrast.

Compare punctuation, fine writing and colored marks. Damage over writing may remain. Missing or obscured detail cannot be recovered. Hard spots, heavy stains and moiré are outside this filter. Cancel if unsure.

Reduce repeating gray bands on near-white paper. Supports straight horizontal, vertical and diagonal bands at a limited set of frequencies. This replaces the page filter and keeps rotation, brightness and contrast.

Compare fine text, tables, graphics and intentional patterns. Patterns outside the detection profile can remain. Intentional gray bands can resemble interference; bands near writing can remain. Color, curved and drifting interference is outside this filter. Obscured detail cannot be recovered. Cancel if unsure.

Restoration reduces noise, fading, color casts and thin scratches on smooth backgrounds. Reconstructed pixels are estimates. Face reconstruction and severe damage recovery are unsupported. The separate sRGB PNG includes visible edits, annotations and signatures at the displayed output size. Use Share-Safe to remove sensitive content.

Search and summaries use exact terms and excerpts from your selected pages. Everything runs on this device. The limit is 3 pages and 32,768 UTF-8 bytes. The rest of your library stays outside the search. OCR can misread text or include words under a visual cover. Use Share-Safe to remove sensitive content.
The comparison reads local copies of two unencrypted PDFs. A match shows agreement with the selected baseline. It cannot establish authenticity or the truth of a document. Originals are preserved.
